q: What should I do if altitude symptoms get worse?
a: Do not ascend. Worsening symptoms at rest, confusion or breathlessness require urgent descent and medical care. Read current CDC guidance and discuss health concerns with a qualified clinician.

q: Are the expedition dates, durations and difficulty ratings guarantees?
a: No. Seasons and durations are indicative summaries; conditions, itineraries, permits and difficulty vary by route and operator. Verify current details with official authorities and a qualified guide.
